def redo(self):
        """ Redo the last undone action.

        This is only possible if no other actions have occurred since the
        last undo call.
        """
        if self._redo_buffer:
            # Redo the last action.
            action = self._redo_buffer.pop()
            self._undo_buffer.append(action)
            action.redo()
            self._redo_buffer.append(action)
            self._modified = True
            self.redo_event()
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("There is no action to redo.")
